description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2009 World Championships, one of the Pokémon SP toolbox decks that Japanese players favored that year; a deck of that kind won the Senior Division too. Skuntank G's Poké-Power Poisons at will, Toxicroak G piles on extra damage, and Luxray GL LV.X's Bright Look switches the opponent's Active Pokémon. The 2009 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, in August 2009.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2009 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
